data.description:
## Acceptance Criteria
- **Callback condition registration.** `registerStorylineOptions` accepts an optional `condition: (state: MainStreetState) => boolean` on each `StorylineOption`. Options whose condition returns `false` are omitted from the presented option list at draw time. *Metric: unit tests for condition true/false/derived-state scenarios.*
- **Callbacks evaluated at draw time, not resolution.** Callback conditions are evaluated when the option list is compiled (at draw time), NOT at resolution time. Mutating state between draw and resolution does not change the presented option list. *Metric: unit test.*
- **No condition defined.** Option behaves identically to legacy behaviour (always included). *Metric: legacy-equivalence test.*
- **Condition receives full MainStreetState.** Callback type parameter matches MainStreetState shape. *Metric: unit test verifying state shape.*

**Parent ACs covered:** AC1 (Callback condition registration), AC3 (Callbacks evaluated at draw time), AC5 (Game-agnostic seam).
data.title: Test: callback conditions on storyline options

data.description:
## Acceptance Criteria
- **Callback successor registration.** `registerStorylineOptions` accepts an optional `successorResolver: (state: MainStreetState) => string | null | undefined` on each `StorylineOption`. When the player selects the option, the callback is invoked at resolution time to determine the pushed successor card. *Metric: unit tests assert correct successor push from callback output.*
- **Callbacks evaluated at draw time, not resolution.** Callback successors are evaluated at resolution time only (the player has already committed). *Metric: unit test.*
- **Null/undefined returns.** `null` and `undefined` from callback end the chain. *Metric: unit test.*
- **No successorResolver.** Falls back to option.successorId (legacy behaviour). *Metric: legacy-equivalence test.*

**Parent ACs covered:** AC2 (Callback successor registration), AC3 (Callbacks evaluated at draw time), AC5 (Game-agnostic seam).
data.title: Test: callback successors on storyline options

data.description:
## Acceptance Criteria
- **Callbacks evaluated at draw time, not resolution.** Callback conditions are evaluated when the option list is compiled (at draw time), NOT at resolution time, because the description explicitly states callbacks must not be trusted to stay stable between draw and resolution. *Metric: unit test.*
- **Options with false condition omitted.** Options with `condition: () => false` are omitted from the presented list. *Metric: unit test.*
- **Options with true condition included.** Options with `condition: () => true` are included. *Metric: unit test.*
- **Registry copy safety.** Filtering does not mutate the stored registry entries. *Metric: unit test.*
- **Legacy options unchanged.** Options without `condition` are unaffected. *Metric: unit test.*

**Parent ACs covered:** AC3 (Callbacks evaluated at draw time, not resolution), AC4 (Declarative path remains default).
data.title: Filter options by condition at compile/draw time

data.description:
## Acceptance Criteria
- **Declarative path remains default.** When no callback successorResolver is present, falls back to option.successorId (legacy behaviour unchanged). *Metric: unit test.*
- **resolveStorylineOption invokes successorResolver.** When present, callback is called and its return used as the pushed successor. *Metric: unit test.*
- **Null/undefined handling.** Null/undefined from callback ends the chain (no card pushed). *Metric: unit test.*
- **Effect policy still applies.** Effect is resolved before successor is determined. *Metric: unit test.*

**Parent ACs covered:** AC4 (Declarative path remains default), AC2 (Callback successor registration).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **AI compatibility.** The AI path (`decideEventChoice`) selects only from the presented option list, which is already filtered by `condition` at draw time. No AI code changes are required. *Metric: Monte Carlo and regression harness run to completion with callback-equipped storylines.*
- **Declarative path remains default.** Existing storylines without callbacks behave identically to pre-change behaviour. *Metric: regression harness.*
- **Full game flow with callbacks.** A callback-equipped storyline works end-to-end from draw to resolution. *Metric: integration test.*
- **Full test suite passes.** All existing tests pass with the new changes. *Metric: `vitest` passes.*

**Parent ACs covered:** AC4 (Declarative path remains default), AC6 (AI compatibility), AC7 (Full project test suite passes).

## Upgrade Path: Affordability Pre-Check Before Animation (AC2)

**Goal:** Applying an upgrade from hand with insufficient coins (or an otherwise illegal target) must leave the action budget, coins, hand, target business and pending selection unchanged, and show illegal feedback WITHOUT starting the transfer animation.

**Problem:** applyHandUpgradeToSlot in src/scenes/MainStreetTurnControllerPlaceSell.ts checks target eligibility (via isEligibleUpgradeTarget) but NOT affordability. It clears pendingHandIndex, sets uiPhase = 'animating', and starts animateTransferFromMarket before the command runs. The command layer then throws during playUpgradeFromHand with 'Not enough coins...'.

**Fix:**
1. Add a non-mutating affordability + target-eligibility predicate (e.g. canPlayUpgradeFromHand) in src/MainStreetEngineCommands.ts mirroring playUpgradeFromHand's checks (target validity, effectiveUpgradeCost after per-business discount) without mutating.
2. In applyHandUpgradeToSlot, run the predicate BEFORE clearing pendingHandIndex / changing uiPhase / starting animation. On failure: playIllegalFeedback, set instruction text, keep the selection and uiPhase, refresh, and return.

**Key files:** src/scenes/MainStreetTurnControllerPlaceSell.ts, src/MainStreetEngineCommands.ts, src/MainStreetMarketPurchase.ts.

**Dependencies:** Blocked by MS-0MUUYAZPN0064AW5 (command-layer atomicity) as a belt-and-suspenders restore guarantee.

## Acceptance Criteria

- A non-mutating predicate (canPlayUpgradeFromHand or equivalent) returns illegal when coins < effective upgrade cost or the target is ineligible, without mutating any state.
- applyHandUpgradeToSlot with insufficient coins performs no transfer animation, leaves actionsRemaining, bankedActions, resourceBank.coins, hand, target business and pendingHandIndex/uiPhase unchanged, and plays playIllegalFeedback with a clear instruction message.
- applyHandUpgradeToSlot with an ineligible target likewise mutates nothing and retains the selection.
- A legal upgrade still animates and applies exactly as before (no regression to the apply-upgrade flow).
- No path leaves uiPhase === 'animating' after a failed upgrade attempt.
data.title: Upgrade Path: Affordability Pre-Check Before Animation

## Drag-Drop Handlers: Pre-Drop Legality Audit (AC3)

**Goal:** Verify that every action-consuming drag-drop path checks legality with a non-mutating predicate before mutation, and consumes the action atomically with a successful operation.

**Scope:**
1. Audit onDragDropBusiness: canPickUpBusinessCard / canDropBusinessCard already gate pickup/drop with non-mutating checks (actionsRemaining, canPurchaseBusiness, affordability against applicable price, tutorial gating, synergy adjacency). Confirm the animation only starts when canDrop passes, and that buyAndPlaceBusinessCommand now restores on throw (MS-0MUUYAZPN0064AW5).
2. Audit onDragDropUpgrade: canPickUpUpgradeCard / canDropUpgradeCard gate premium affordability and eligibility. Confirm no path starts the transfer animation before a non-mutating legality check.
3. Enumerate the remaining action-consuming handlers from AC3 (onBusinessCardClick, onEventCardClick, onUpgradeCardClick, onStaffCardClick, onRefreshMarketClick, onPeekClick, onCommunityFavourClick, close-business, end-turn) and record for each whether a pre-mutation legality check exists. Any offender found: fix inline (retain selection, playIllegalFeedback) or record as a discovered-from child work item if it exceeds minimal remediation.
4. Confirm no path leaves uiPhase === 'animating' after a failed attempt.

**Key files:** src/scenes/MainStreetTurnControllerDragDrop.ts, src/scenes/MainStreetTurnControllerMarketActions.ts, src/scenes/MainStreetTurnControllerPlaceSell.ts, src/scenes/MainStreetTurnControllerTurnFlow.ts.

## Acceptance Criteria

- An audit note (comment on this item) lists every action-consuming UI handler in AC3 with a verdict: pre-mutation non-mutating legality check present, or fixed.
- onDragDropBusiness and onDragDropUpgrade start the transfer animation only after a non-mutating legality predicate passes.
- No audited path leaves uiPhase === 'animating' after a failed attempt.
- Any offender beyond minimal remediation is recorded as a discovered-from work item with a clear description.
data.title: Drag-Drop Handlers: Pre-Drop Legality Audit
